---
title: "Ex1 - Filtering and Sorting Data (Chipotle) - Solutions"
output: html_document
---

This time we are going to pull data directly from the internet.
Special thanks to: https://github.com/justmarkham for sharing the dataset and materials.

### Step 1. Import the necessary libraries

```{r step1, message=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

### Step 2. Import the dataset from this [address](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justmarkham/DAT8/master/data/chipotle.tsv).

### Step 3. Assign it to a variable called chipo.

```{r}
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justmarkham/DAT8/master/data/chipotle.tsv"

chipo <- read_tsv(url, na = c("", "NA", "NULL"))
```

### Step 4. How many products cost more than $10.00?

```{r}
# the item price column is actually the price of the product multiplied by the quantity
chipo |> filter(choice_description == "[Diet Coke]", item_name == "Canned Soda")
```

```{r}
# adding a new column representing the price of each single product as a number
chipo <- chipo |>
  mutate(item_price = as.numeric(str_remove(item_price, fixed("$"))),
         product_price = item_price / quantity)
chipo
```

```{r}
# checking everything is correct
chipo |> filter(choice_description == "[Diet Coke]", item_name == "Canned Soda")
```

```{r}
# removing duplicated products (distinct() keeps the first row of each combination)
filtered_chipo <- chipo |> distinct(item_name, choice_description, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# filtering products that cost more than $10
filtered_chipo <- filtered_chipo |>
  filter(product_price > 10) |>
  select(item_name, choice_description, product_price)
```

```{r}
cat("the number of products that cost more than $10.00 is", nrow(filtered_chipo), "\n")
```

### Step 5. What is the price of each item?

###### print a data frame with only three columns item_name choice_description and product_price

```{r}
filtered_chipo |> select(item_name, choice_description, product_price)
```

### Step 6. Sort by the name of the item

```{r}
sort(chipo$item_name) |> head(10)

# OR

chipo |> arrange(item_name)
```

### Step 7. What was the quantity of the most expensive item ordered?

```{r}
chipo |>
  slice_max(item_price, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  pull(quantity)
```

### Step 8. How many times was a Veggie Salad Bowl ordered?

```{r}
chipo |>
  filter(item_name == "Veggie Salad Bowl") |>
  summarise(times = sum(quantity))
```

### Step 9. How many times did someone order more than one Canned Soda?

```{r}
chipo |>
  filter(item_name == "Canned Soda", quantity > 1) |>
  nrow()
```
